raw:
Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator prematurely marked the task as satisfied and supplied a BioMart/Ensembl gene-specific URL (pointing to ROS_Cfam_1.0) instead of a proper download link to the dog genome files relevant as of May 2020. This ignored the timeframe (May 2020, when CanFam3.1 was the widely used reference) and provided a page not centered on file downloads, leading to an incorrect and non-generalizable link.
